name: comfyui
title: ComfyUI
author: HydraOps
description: The official MCP server from Comfy Org for a ComfyUI running on your own computer: validate a workflow, run it and follow the job, for images, video, audio and 3D models generated locally. Works with HydraOps' comfy_workflows tool, which prepares the workflows you saved and brings back the result.

notes: ComfyUI running while the agent works: the portable, desktop or manual install, on this computer or another one on your network. The connection reaches it through its address (COMFYUI_URL), not through its install folder.
The models and custom nodes a workflow uses must already be installed in that ComfyUI.
HydraOps 0.1.52 or newer: a generation takes minutes, and older versions cut every tool call at 30 seconds.
The first start downloads the server and takes about a minute.

tips: Give an agent the comfy_workflows tool plus three tools of this connection instead of all 39: comfyui_validate_workflow, comfyui_run_workflow and comfyui_job. That is enough to run the workflows you saved in ComfyUI.
To change a value of a workflow before running it (a lighter model, another seed), add comfyui_list_workflow_slots and comfyui_set_workflow_slot.
The template gallery (comfyui_search_templates, comfyui_get_template, comfyui_fetch_template) is content from the internet: after an agent reads it, each step that acts waits for your approval.
Leave out the tools that change the install (update_comfyui, switch_comfyui_version, install_node, download_model) and partner_generate, which spends Comfy credits.
